China Tourism & Business Group Tour 2026

Explore Shanghai & Guangzhou with Agha Travel & Tours

Discover the best of China with our exclusive 7-day Tourism & Business Group Tour. Experience the breathtaking skyline of Shanghai, explore Guangzhou’s cultural landmarks, enjoy thrilling adventures at Gulong Gorge, and discover exciting business and shopping opportunities in China’s wholesale markets. Whether you’re a travel enthusiast, entrepreneur, or business professional, this carefully organized tour offers the perfect combination of sightseeing, adventure, comfort, and business networking.

DestinationsShanghai & Guangzhou, China
Departure3rd week of November 2026
Duration7 Days / 6 Nights
Departure cityIslamabad, Pakistan
AirlineChina Southern Airlines
Accommodation4-star hotels

01 Tour Highlights

Shanghai’s Bund & Yu Garden

Stroll the iconic Bund waterfront and the historic Yu Garden.

Canton Tower

See the magnificent Canton Tower and Guangzhou’s famous attractions.

Gulong Gorge adventure

Waterfalls, glass bridges, skywalks and rafting in one unforgettable day.

Chinese culture

Chen Clan Ancestral Hall and Yuexiu Park.

Wholesale markets

Business opportunities, shopping and product sourcing in Guangzhou.

Bilingual guidance

Professional bilingual tour guides and China-based business assistance.

  1. Day1
    Shanghai

    Arrival & first evening

    Arrival in China, transfer to Shanghai, hotel check-in and evening exploration.

  2. Day2
    Shanghai

    The Bund & Yu Garden

    Shanghai sightseeing, including The Bund, Yu Garden, and local shopping.

  3. Day3
    Guangzhou

    Domestic flight to Guangzhou, hotel check-in and evening city exploration.

  4. Day4

    Guangzhou

    Business market visits, wholesale shopping, product sourcing, and supplier guidance.

    Hotel check-out and return flight to Pakistan.

03 What’s Included

Package Inclusions

  • Return international air tickets
  • China tourist visa
  • Shanghai–Guangzhou domestic flight
  • 6 nights in 4-star hotels (2 nights Shanghai, 4 nights Guangzhou)
  • Daily breakfast and halal dinner
  • Private air-conditioned transportation
  • Airport transfers and guided sightseeing
  • Attraction entrance tickets as per itinerary
  • Chinese bilingual tour guide
  • Travel SIM and paid VPN
  • Business market guidance, supplier introductions, and sourcing assistance

Exclusions

  • Lunch
  • Personal shopping
  • Laundry services
  • Activities not mentioned in the itinerary
